reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Expressed strong disagreement with the proposed function and suggested a different approach. Proposed additional helper functions to check for zero-page mappings, rather than adding a single `pte_none_or_zero()` function.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes adding a new helper function `pte_none_or_zero()` to the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) subsystem. The function is intended to simplify code that needs to check if a page table entry (PTE) maps nothing or the shared zero-page, treating both cases as equivalent. The patch moves an existing local helper from khugepaged.c to pgtable.h and converts another instance in migrate_device.c to use the new function.
